messages:
Aisha Khan: Opening a support case with AWS — we hit ENI + P4d instance quotas in us-east-1 while trying to provision Dedicated pool for upcoming benchmark runs. Case 9876543210 created. Please follow here and ping me if you need extra justification.
Rafael Ortiz: Can you paste the case link/number and the exact quotas requested? I'll loop in finance if they ask for spend commitment.
Aisha Khan: Case 9876543210. Requesting: P4d capacity -> increase to 120 instances; EC2 ENI quota -> increase to 600 in us-east-1; EFA support verified per-instance. Support asked for projected sustained usage and attach architecture diagram.
Sam Lee: Thanks. Quick question — are we requesting soft quota (service-quotas) or account vCPU/eni hard limits? AWS sometimes splits these. Also which account ID?
Aisha Khan: It's tied to account 111122223333. They called out two quotas: L-XXXXX (P4d instances) and L-YYYYY (ENI per region). I attached the workbook with expected ramp: 0->40->80->120 over next 6 weeks and linked the security/compliance SOW.
Priya Nair: FYI finance wants an estimate of monthly spend at 80 and 120 instances for approval. Rough calc: p4d ~ $32/hr on-demand -> ~23k/day for 30 instances. I'll drop a real calc in the ticket thread.
AWS Support: Hello Aisha, we've received case 9876543210. Please confirm the business justification and whether the instances will be spread across AZs. Also provide any supporting ARNs. We may request TAM escalation for faster approval.
Aisha Khan: Confirmed, we'll run across 3 AZs in us-east-1 for HA. Justification: production inference fleet for Redwood Dedicated customers with SLA obligations. ARNs attached in the ticket.
Rafael Ortiz: Tagging @aws-tam-bot — can we request expedited review? This blocks scheduled perf runs next week.
aws-tam-bot: TAM assigned: John Lewis. ETA on expedited review: 48 hours. Please provide architecture doc + expected burn rate. John will coordinate with quota engineering.
devops-bot: Sanity check script to pre-validate quotas before provisioning: 
```
aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-XXXXX --region us-east-1
aws ec2 describe-instances --filters "Name=instance-type,Values=p4d.24xlarge"
```
Sam Lee: If AWS needs spend confirmation, we can offer a short-term reserved capacity commitment for the Dedicated product to justify the increase. Drafting an email to sales/legal.
Aisha Khan: Update from support: They requested an owner confirmation email (account owner) and the expected start date. After that they can approve a temporary quota bump while quota engineering reviews. John (TAM) asked for a 1:1 call.
Rafael Ortiz: I'll send owner confirmation now and schedule a 30m with John. Can someone paste the perf run dates to include in the call invite?
Priya Nair: Perf runs scheduled: staging -> Mon 03/23, production rollout -> Mon 03/30. Including those should speed approval.
AWS Support: Update: we've escalated to quota engineering. Temporary increase granted: P4d -> 100 instances, ENI -> 400 for 72 hours while we finalize. Permanent increase under review. Case 9876543210 will remain open. Reference escalation ID E-2026-0457.
Aisha Khan: Great progress — marking action items: (1) Rafael send owner email (done), (2) Priya attach spend estimate, (3) Sam prepare commit language if asked, (4) I will update provisioning to check quotas and fallback region. 
Sam Lee: I'll add fallback region logic to k8s-provisioner and gate run if quotas insufficient.
Rafael Ortiz: Call with John scheduled for tomorrow 10:00am ET. I'll paste notes here after.
Aisha Khan: Thanks team. Once quota engineering confirms permanent bump, we should add a runbook: who to call, case pattern, and cost center. :thumbsup:
